nodes.label: Governance: public-claim rules in CLAIMS_REGISTER.md and editorial controls in EDITORIAL_FACT_CHECK.md take precedence over this strategy doc; src/data/topical-map.ts supports navigation only, not an authority for public claims

Primary offer and audience: SEO-safe migrations for WordPress/Webflow/GoHighLevel; primary buyer is a founder/marketing/ecommerce/ops leader facing a redesign, rebrand, acquisition, or platform-failure trigger
Search-intent model: commercial (/, /services, /pricing, /work), transactional (audit/quote/contact/scheduling), navigational (/about, /work, /manifesto, policy), informational (/blog)

SEO/AEO/GEO principles: generative search features use the same crawlability/indexability/quality/usefulness foundations as ordinary search; no special AI file, schema type, or chunking tactic guarantees inclusion; llms.txt is a navigation aid only
Topic and entity boundaries: core subject is website-platform migration and continuity engineering; avoid unrelated general marketing, generic tutorials, and standalone branding services
Internal-linking rules: vertical (pillar<->article), horizontal (shared task/topic), navigational (breadcrumbs), contextual (natural anchors), canonical (link to canonical destination not redirects)

Content and evidence standard: choose format because it helps the reader, not because it is assumed to be a ranking signal; apply the editorial fact-check workflow before publishing material assertions
Freshness and date integrity: src/data/blog.ts is the sitemap lastModified source; datePublished never changes; dateModified/visible date/sitemap lastModified must agree on material updates

Measurement: index coverage/canonical selection, non-brand impressions/CTR, generative-search visibility, referral sessions, qualified migration-plan starts, win rate, margin, delivery variance, performance/conversion trends by route
